name: Althea Ebonlocke
summary: Darkshire depends on Althea Ebonlocke and the Night Watch to hold Duskwood’s horrors at bay. A relative of Mayor Ello Ebonlocke, she leads the town guard in an isolated region left without Stormwind’s regular troops.

sections.title: Commander of the Watch
sections.body: Althea Ebonlocke directs Darkshire’s defense while her relative, Mayor Ello Ebonlocke, governs from the town hall. When Stormwind sent no royal troops to guard Duskwood from its horrors, the townspeople formed the Night Watch. Under Althea’s firm command, its volunteers patrol the foggy roads and keep undead skeletons, fierce wolves, and spiders from overrunning the town’s edge.

sections.title: A Town on the Brink
sections.body: Althea knows how little her militia can do alone. Recruits are scarce, and the Watch keeps losing them, so she enlists passing mercenaries and travelers to thin the threats near Darkshire. She directs efforts against ghouls and skeletons in the forest’s quiet, sorrowful graveyards, while watching for darker rumors from deep in the woods.

sections.title: Tragedies of the Wood
sections.body: Althea coordinates the search for Duskwood’s greatest blights and the effort to destroy them. She helps unravel the dark fate of Stalvan Mistmantle and seeks answers to the restless wandering of Mor'Ladim, the fallen knight Morgan Ladimore. When Abercrombie sends the monstrous abomination Stitches down the main road, Althea’s Night Watch turns out along the road to face it.

aliases: who is the night watch commander
faq.answer: Althea Ebonlocke commands the Night Watch, Darkshire’s militia in Duskwood. She organizes the region’s defense against the undead and beasts lurking in the shadows.

The Night Watch is a volunteer militia formed by Darkshire’s citizens. With almost no military support from Stormwind, the townspeople patrol the roads under Althea’s command and fight the horrors in the woods.

faq.q: How is Althea related to Mayor Ello Ebonlocke?
faq.answer: Althea is a relative of Mayor Ello Ebonlocke, who governs Darkshire from the town hall. She commands the militia in the field.

faq.q: Why is Stormwind not helping Althea defend Darkshire?
faq.answer: Stormwind’s resources are strained, and with King Varian Wrynn missing, the House of Nobles has largely neglected the kingdom’s outer territories. Darkshire receives almost no soldiers or relief, so Althea relies on local volunteers and freelance adventurers.

faq.q: What quests does Commander Althea offer?
faq.answer: Althea sends adventurers to hunt wolves, skeletal fiends, and ghouls across Duskwood. She also helps investigate the Legend of Stalvan and confront the wandering terror Mor'Ladim.

faq.q: What does Althea do when Stitches attacks Darkshire?
faq.answer: When Abercrombie’s stitched abomination Stitches lumbers down the road toward Darkshire, Althea’s Night Watch guards turn out to face it. Without help from adventurers, the monster can cut straight through them.

angles.text: Althea shows the Alliance’s grim resolve on forgotten frontiers, holding the kingdom together where the crown’s armies have withdrawn.
As a warrior, you may respect Althea’s stern, practical command. She values discipline and fighters willing to hold the line against overwhelming odds.
As a paladin, you can help Althea put restless souls to peace on Duskwood’s gloomy roads, easing some of the spiritual dread weighing on her militia.
